parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or an STS token for authentication.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Specifies the organization ID. You can obtain this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL. For example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the repository.

parameters.name: sha
parameters.description: A commit reference, such as a branch name, tag name, or commit ID.

parameters.name: showSignature
parameters.description: Specifies whether to show the signature. The default value is false.
